info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Assignment Management API
info.description: The Employee Assignment Management API facilitates the retrieval of employee assignment details within an organization. This API serves as a resource for human resources and management teams to access current assignments, track employee roles, and assess workforce allocation. Typical use cases involve querying employee status or monitoring changes in assignments. By providing quick access to pertinent employee data, organizations can enhance efficiency and make informed decisions regarding personnel management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of current employee assignments within the human resource management system, enabling effective resource allocation and management.

requestBody.description: A request body containing parameters for fetching employee assignment data within the human resource management system.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the employee assignment data.
